hero.heading: Honour someone who lifts others
hero.intro: Do you know someone who inspires, builds, serves or excels? Put their name forward for a Sankofa Royale Award.

categoriesIntro: Nominees are considered across nineteen categories. Choose the one that best reflects the impact of the person or organisation you are nominating.

categories.name: Community Leadership Award
categories.description: Promotes community unity, equity and inclusivity.

categories.name: Cultural Diversity & Inclusion
categories.description: Champions diversity, breaks barriers and celebrates heritage.

categories.name: Humanitarian & Volunteer Service
categories.description: Celebrates selfless dedication to improving lives through volunteering.

categories.name: Women Empowerment Award
categories.description: Honours women leaders championing equity and opportunity for others.

categories.name: Youth Leadership Award
categories.description: Spotlights young people who show vision, initiative and courage.

categories.name: Education & Mentorship
categories.description: Honours those shaping the future through teaching and guidance.

categories.name: Entrepreneurship & Business
categories.description: Celebrates innovation, resilience and integrity in business.

categories.name: Faith & Community Service
categories.description: Recognises service rooted in faith that brings hope to the community.

categories.name: Non-Profit Leadership Award
categories.description: Honours visionary leadership driving change in the non-profit sector.

categories.name: Corporate Social Responsibility
categories.description: Celebrates businesses that lead with purpose and reinvest locally.

categories.name: Global Community Impact
categories.description: Honours work whose positive effect reaches across borders.

categories.name: Lifetime Achievement Award
categories.description: Celebrates a lifetime of leadership, legacy and exceptional impact.

categories.name: Health & Wellness Award
categories.description: Honours people and groups promoting holistic community wellness.

categories.name: Accessibility & Disability Inclusion
categories.description: Celebrates advocates for equity and empowerment for people with disabilities.

categories.name: Human Trafficking Prevention
categories.description: Honours advocacy that combats exploitation and protects survivors.

categories.name: Arts, Culture & Heritage
categories.description: Spotlights artists and keepers of tradition who keep our heritage vibrant.

categories.name: Public Service
categories.description: Honours public servants who lead with civic duty and integrity.

categories.name: Environmental Stewardship
categories.description: Recognises sustainable initiatives that protect our environment.

categories.name: Emerging Leader
categories.description: Celebrates newcomers showing early promise of great impact.

items.title: Choose a category
items.text: Pick the category that best matches your nominee's contribution.

items.title: Tell their story
items.text: Share your name, phone and email, then a short statement of what your nominee has achieved and who has benefited.

items.title: Submit the form
items.text: Send the nomination through our secure online form. You can nominate more than one person.

items.title: Review & celebration
items.text: The committee reviews every nomination. Honourees are contacted before the gala and celebrated on stage.

criteria.heading: What the committee looks for
items: Measurable, lasting impact on people and communities
Service beyond personal or commercial gain
Integrity, leadership and the respect of peers
Work that represents and uplifts Black and African communities

honourRoll.heading: 2024 nominees
honourRoll.body: Last year's nominees came from every corner of our community. Browse their portraits in the gallery.
